Lighting and treatment: the film's own look: a deep slate background (#171A1E) with faint graph-paper lines, a glossy blue mannequin figure with no face, soft cool key light and a magenta (#EB63FF) accent; clean, minimal, high contrast, stylised 3-D render.
Mood: disbelief and wonder.
Text: "310 LAPS" in heavy white condensed sans-serif, "LAPS" in magenta, placed upper middle. No other text.
Scientific accuracy: the thread is a chain of everyone on Earth holding hands, about 12.3 million km, wound about 310 times round the equator; it is a diagram, not a photograph.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces, realistic people, logos, watermarks, extra text, or anything that looks like a real photograph.
Style: premium, art-directed, minimal 3-D science illustration that matches a clean code-rendered animation; not photorealistic, not generic AI art.
